title: Verify that the English Economic Research page renders left-to-right with the designed copy

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads left-to-right

steps.action: Inspect the hero and quick-facts strip
steps.expected: The hero shows 'Research & Studies' above 'Economic Research' with its description constrained to its designed width and the banner image beside it; the quick facts read Content, Coverage, Audience and Source

steps.action: Inspect the section index and Section 01
steps.expected: The index reads 01 Overview and 02 Research library; Section 01 renders the badge 'About the service' above the heading 'Overview' and its rich-text body

steps.action: Inspect Section 02 and its report cards
steps.expected: Section 02 renders the badge 'Research library' above 'Published research and studies' and the intro 'Browse published reports and open any card to read its summary, metadata, and key topics before downloading the full PDF.', followed by the report cards

title: Verify that the Arabic Economic Research page renders right-to-left with Arabic copy throughout

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in Arabic
steps.expected: Page loads right-to-left

steps.action: Inspect the hero and quick-facts strip
steps.expected: The hero renders its eyebrow, title and description in Arabic, right-aligned, with the banner image mirrored to the opposite side

steps.action: Inspect the section index and both sections
steps.expected: Every section badge, heading and body renders in Arabic with no English text left in a translated field

steps.action: Inspect the layout direction of the index, the cards and the download buttons
steps.expected: The section index sits on the mirrored side, each report card places its thumbnail on the mirrored side of its text, and the Download PDF button's icon sits on the mirrored side of its label

title: Verify that the report preview view renders right-to-left in Arabic

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in Arabic
steps.expected: The page loads right-to-left in Arabic

steps.action: Click a report card to open the preview view
steps.expected: The preview view opens for that report

steps.action: Inspect the title, summary, metadata and publish date
steps.expected: The report's title, summary and metadata render in Arabic, right-aligned, and the publish date is localised for Arabic

steps.action: Inspect the download action
steps.expected: The download action's label renders in Arabic and serves the same PDF as the English view

title: Verify that the hero renders its eyebrow, title, description and banner image in the designed layout

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Inspect the hero region
steps.expected: The hero renders the maroon gradient with the breadcrumb above the eyebrow, the eyebrow above the title and the description below it

steps.action: Measure the hero text against its container
steps.expected: None of the three text elements overflows or is clipped, and the description is constrained to its designed 648px width rather than spanning edge to edge

steps.action: Inspect the banner image
steps.expected: The banner image renders beside the text at its designed size with its drop shadow, correctly scaled and not distorted

title: Verify that the quick-facts strip renders each active tile with its icon, label and value

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Inspect the quick-facts strip attached to the foot of the hero
steps.expected: The strip renders one tile per active quick fact, evenly divided by vertical rules

steps.action: Inspect each tile in turn
steps.expected: Each tile shows its icon beside its label and value, with no tile missing an icon and no label wrapping into its neighbour

steps.action: Compare the tiles against the values stored in the CMS
steps.expected: The rendered labels and values match the CMS exactly — Content / Market Intelligence, Coverage / All Sectors, Audience / Businesses & Investors and Source / Official Publications

title: Verify that every report card renders all five of its designed elements

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Scroll to Section 02 Research library
steps.expected: The library renders one card per published report

steps.action: Inspect every rendered card in turn
steps.expected: Every card shows a thumbnail, a title, a short description, a publish date and a Download PDF button — none renders a blank thumbnail slot, an empty description area or a missing date

steps.action: Compare each card's values against its CMS record
steps.expected: Each card's title, description and publish date match its CMS record exactly

title: Verify that the report preview view shows the report's summary, metadata and key topics

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the library rendered

steps.action: Click a report card to open the preview view
steps.expected: The preview view opens for the clicked report

steps.action: Inspect every element of the preview
steps.expected: The preview shows the report title, its summary, its publish date and its download action, none of them clipped or empty

steps.action: Compare them against that report's CMS record
steps.expected: Every displayed value matches that report's CMS record; no other report's content appears in the view

title: Verify that a report thumbnail with an unexpected aspect ratio still renders inside its card frame

steps.action: Log in to Liferay CMS as a Site Content Editor and open a research report record
steps.expected: The report record opens with its current thumbnail

steps.action: Replace the thumbnail with a 2000x400 wide image and publish
steps.expected: The wide image is accepted and the card renders it cropped or fitted within its frame, without stretching the card

steps.action: Replace it with a 400x2000 tall image and publish
steps.expected: The tall image is accepted and the card renders it cropped or fitted within the same frame

steps.action: Open the public Economic Research page in English and inspect that card after each change
steps.expected: In both cases the card keeps its designed height and border radius, and the title, description, date and button stay in their designed positions

title: Verify that a failure to load the Economic Research page shows the standard site error page

steps.action: Request the Economic Research URL with the content service unavailable
steps.expected: The request completes

steps.action: Observe the response
steps.expected: The visitor sees the site's standard error page with the site header and footer, not a raw stack trace, a Liferay diagnostic screen or a blank page

steps.action: Request an Economic Research report URL that does not exist
steps.expected: The request completes

steps.action: Observe that response
steps.expected: The visitor sees the site's standard not-found page in the current language
